embeddingModelListLoadFailed: Could not load embedding model list.
interfacesLlmDescription: Chat providers (OpenAI-compatible endpoints), optional smart routing.
benchSubtitle: Compare LLM providers on fixed agent scenarios (smoke, workspace, social). Runs use real chat + tools.
benchStatsHint: Aggregated from completed benchmark runs (provider + model). Sorted by pass rate, then average latency.
benchStatsClearHint: Clears run history via “Clear history…” — stats are recalculated from the same database.
benchStatsLeaderboardHint: Overall pass rate and latency across all scenarios in the selected scope.
benchStatsByScenarioHint: Which model passes most often and runs fastest for each scenario.
benchStatsNoData: No completed runs with results yet.
benchBulkDeleteHint: Deletes finished runs from the database (history and stats). Queued or running runs are kept.
benchBulkDeletePreview: {{count}} finished run(s) match — will be deleted.
benchBulkDeleteNone: No matching finished runs to delete.
benchDbProfilesHint: LLM endpoints from Admin → Interfaces and LLM_PROVIDER_* in .env (same as chat).
benchDbProfilesSelectHint: Select providers to compare. API key optional for local stacks (Ollama). Pick one or more models per provider.
benchTooManyProfiles: At most {{max}} model profiles per run (currently {{count}}). Remove some models or providers.
benchDbProfilesEmpty: No LLM providers — add LLM_PROVIDER_1_* in .env or endpoints under
benchSecretsHint: Optional suite secrets in .env: AGENT_BENCH_GMAIL_SECRET, AGENT_BENCH_SSC_SECRET.
benchRunIdentityHint: Runs as the selected user; secrets come from that account.
benchRunIdentityDesc: Workspaces, secrets, and permissions use the run-as account.
benchFriendUserEmpty: No user-role accounts — create one under Users
benchFriendUserHint: Second user for friend/block-share scenarios. Friendship is set up automatically.
benchSecretsAutoHint: Scenarios that need Gmail or SSC use these secrets automatically — configure them once for the run-as user above.
benchWorkspaceIndexHint: On = index git workspace before run. Off = skip. Needs Embedding endpoint set up.
benchSecretsManageHint: Secrets are per user — configure while logged in as the run-as user, or use Settings →
benchSkipGmail: gmail secret missing on run-as user
benchModelCatalogEmpty: No models from GET /v1/models — type the model id manually.
benchModelCatalogUnreachable: Provider unreachable ({{detail}}) — check URL/network or type model id manually.
benchRunNote: One run at a time per tenant. Runs as {{user}}.
benchPrefsPersistHint: Selections are saved in this browser (suite, providers, models, scenarios, limits).
benchScenarioTimeoutHint: Max wall-clock time per scenario. Sends cancel to the agent when exceeded (min 30s).
benchMaxToolRoundsHint: Overrides each scenario's agent_max_tool_rounds for this run only.
benchScenarioFailureRetriesHint: After a failed scenario (not skipped), rerun from scratch up to this many extra times (0 = no retries).
benchScenarioFailureRetriesInvalid: Retries must be an integer from 0 to 20.
benchPromptLocaleHint: User message language sent to the agent for every scenario in this run.
benchTimeoutInvalid: Scenario timeout must be at least 30 seconds.
benchMaxRoundsInvalid: Max tool rounds must be a positive number.
benchDeleteRunDescription: Permanently delete run "{{suite}}". This cannot be undone.
benchDeleteRunConfirm: Delete benchmark run "{{suite}}"? This cannot be undone.
benchDeleteRunActive: Cannot delete while the run is queued or still running.
benchSelectRun: Select a run to see scenario results.
benchRunWaitingResults: Fixture setup or first scenario in progress…
benchDetailResponseFromStream: reconstructed from websocket stream (no final completion)
benchDetailLegacyHint: This run was stored before full diagnostics — re-run the benchmark to capture the prompt and full response.
benchWorkspaceQuota: Workspaces: {{count}} total · user {{headroom}}/{{quota}} free · benchmark {{bench}} tagged
benchWorkspaceQuotaFull: Workspace quota full — W/C scenarios need workspace.create. Use “Clean benchmark sandboxes” below, delete other workspaces, or raise quota in Admin → Users.
benchSandboxResources: Benchmark sandboxes left: {{workspaces}} workspaces · {{dashboards}} dashboards · {{conversations}} conversations
benchCleanupWorkspacesHint: Deletes all benchmark-tagged workspaces, dashboards, and conversations for the run-as user (same as automatic cleanup at run start). Manual cleanup anytime; finish cleanup runs automatically unless you retain sandboxes below.
benchRetainWorkspacesHint: Skip automatic cleanup when the benchmark finishes (for debugging). Start cleanup still runs so quota stays free.
benchCleanupSummary: removed {{workspaces}} workspaces, {{dashboards}} dashboards, {{conversations}} conversations · left {{benchWsRemaining}} ws / {{benchDashRemaining}} dash / {{benchConvRemaining}} conv · {{headroom}} ws headroom
benchDetailNoToolsForwarded: Context window unknown (0 tokens) — no tool definitions were sent to the model. It may write fake tool_code in text instead of real tool calls.
benchNeedProfile: Select at least one LLM provider (.env or Admin → Interfaces).
benchNeedModel: Each selected endpoint needs at least one model.
benchScenariosHint: Pick which tasks to run. Each scenario has a fixed prompt and automated rubric.
benchFixturesHint: Auto-selected from scenarios. Optional fixtures may skip if env is missing.
interfacesBridgesDescription: Discord and Telegram in-process gateways. Users link accounts under Settings → Connections.
interfacesPlatformDescription: Agent execution mode, dashboard upload limits, and workspace self-edit.
interfacesMemoryDescription: Embedding endpoints (separate from chat), RAG tuning, memory, and memory graph.
messagePrefixLabel: Message prefix (must match start of message);
messagePrefixEmptyHint: = no prefix (every message is a prompt)
messagePrefixEmptyHintTelegram: = no prefix (every text message is a prompt)
messagePrefixPlaceholder: e.g. !agent  — leave empty for no prefix
httpClientLogWarning: WARNING — default (quiet, no line per getUpdates)
effectiveRunContextTitle: Effective run context from manifest + Interfaces (AGENT_MODE). Not set on this page.
effectiveMinRoleTitle: Effective minimum role for this caller (manifest + operator policy).
adminDashboardIntro: Operator console. Use the sidebar for platform settings, automation, users, and traces. Everything here requires an admin session.
createScheduleHelp: Writes a new row to scheduler_jobs.
schedulesPermanentDeleteConfirm: Delete this schedule permanently? This cannot be undone.
toolsPolicyMinRole: Minimum role to use this package
toolsPolicyTenantIds: Allowed tenant IDs (empty = any tenant; numbers = tenants.id)
agentsIntro: Personas and tool policy (domains + capabilities). Resolved tool names come from the live registry; effective tools also apply operator policy from Tool registry.
agentsEditHint: Edit agent.yaml and system_prompt.md under plugins/agents/<id>/ — changes require a server reload.
agentTracesSubtitle: Persisted runs and correlated tool invocations (debug / operator).
agentTracesSelectHint: Select a run to inspect tools and child runs.
usersPageIntro: Password accounts in the database. Each user belongs to one tenant (users.tenant_id): same login always resolves to that tenant for chat, tools, and policy (Bearer/JWT or API key — no identity headers). Create named tenants (e.g. work, friends), then assign users here; use those numeric id values in tool allowlists on Admin → Tools.
usersCreateTenantApi: POST /v1/admin/tenants — adds a row in tenants (new numeric id for allowlists and user assignment).
pluginCronIntro: This section is for plugin background cron jobs, not for user Schedules (scheduler_jobs), not ComfyUI image graphs and not for future user-defined step workflows (n8n-style). Those jobs are discovered from the same scan paths as tools: any .py file that defines HANDLERS and RUN_EVERY_MINUTES is registered by scheduled_job_registry and run by the in-process cron thread (src/infrastructure/cron.py).
pluginCronLlmNote: LLM tools stay separate: they use the normal tool registry and are invoked by the agent per chat round — see Admin → Tools.
pluginCronNoApi: No admin API is wired here yet (list jobs, enable/disable). Use logs and code until this page is extended.
operatorSaveDashboardUploadInvalid: Dashboard upload: max file MB must be empty (use env) or an integer ≥ 1.
operatorSaveSmartRoutingInvalid: Smart routing: invalid numbers (see help text for limits).
operatorSaveRagInvalid: RAG: invalid numbers (Dim 32–4096, Chunk 200–8000, Overlap 0–2000, Top-K 1–50, Timeout 5–600).
operatorSaveMemGraphInvalid: Memory graph: invalid numbers (Hops 0–4, Score 0–1, Bullets 1–50, Chars 200–50000).
operatorSaveInterfacesPartial: Interfaces saved, but operator settings failed: {{detail}}
operatorSaveLlmMissingUrl: External LLM: endpoint {{n}}: base URL missing (or remove row).
operatorSaveLlmMissingKey: External LLM: new endpoint {{n}}: API key required.
operatorSaveLlmEndpointsPartial: Settings saved, but external LLM endpoints: {{detail}}
operatorSaveOkBridges: Saved. In-process Discord/Telegram bridges pick up token/enable changes after the current session reconnects (or restart the container).
externalModelsEmpty: The API returned no models (empty list).
ifLlmMaxParallelHint: Concurrent HTTP slots for this endpoint (1–64). Match your server (e.g. llama.cpp --parallel). Default 1.
ifLlmQueueIntro: When all parallel slots are busy, new requests wait in a queue. Default: chat users rotate fairly (round-robin), benchmarks wait at the lowest tier.
ifLlmQueuePolicyHint: Default priority: chat users rotate fairly; scheduler and benchmark lower; benchmarks last.
ifLlmQueueBenchmarkHint: Keep below user priority so benchmarks do not starve interactive chat.
operatorSaveLlmQueueInvalid: LLM queue priorities must be integers between 0 and 1000.
usersLlmPrioHint: Optional override (0–1000, higher = sooner). Empty = class default from Interfaces.
llmQueuePriorityUpdateFailed: Could not update LLM queue priority.
ifAutomationDbHint: Settings are stored in the database (here), not in environment variables.
adminToolsPolicyHint: minimum role, and optional tenant allowlist (comma-separated tenants.id);
ifMemSaveSyncHint: After Save the server syncs model/dim with the provider.
externalModelsLoaded: {{count}} model names loaded — suggestions appear when typing in the fields below.
ifMemApiKeyLabel: API key (leave empty = keep stored key)
ifMemEnvOverridesDbUrl: overrides the DB. Leave the field empty in .env to store the URL below.
ifMemNoBaseUrl: No base URL yet — set EMBEDDING_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter a URL in Admin and save.
ifLlmNoEndpoints: No endpoints yet — set LLM_PROVIDER_1_* in .env or add an endpoint.
ifMemMemoryRagIntro: Toggles and tuning in operator_settings. Tool packages under Admin → Tools.
ifMemExposeErrors: Expose internal error text in API responses (5xx/502) — debugging only
ifMemGraphIntro: Structured nodes/edges + prompt injection. Requires memory enabled above.
ifMemGraphEnable: Enable graph storage and context injection
ifMemGraphLog: Write activation log (node ids, hashed query — no raw text)
ifMemEmbedIntro: Separate from chat. Numbered env: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL → embedding_provider_1, … Pick the active provider below (or auto: first configured). Admin DB endpoint = embedding_admin when URL is set here.
ifLlmEndpointsIntro: Each entry = one provider in the chat model dropdown (provider_33, provider_34, …). Use the preset dropdown to prefill URL, or enter manually. Env bootstrap: LLM_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL → provider_1, LLM_PROVIDER_2_* → provider_2, … Embeddings (RAG/memory): Interfaces → Memory & RAG.
ifLlmSmartRoutingIntro: Experimental: heuristic + small router model on LLM_ROUTER_PROVIDER_ID (default: first env provider). Chat otherwise uses the catalog provider chosen in the composer.
ifLlmRouterModel: Router model (local catalog provider, small, e.g. 3–6B)
ifLlmRouteLongChars: Long last user message from (chars) → prefer external
ifLlmRouteShortChars: Short message up to (chars) → prefer local
ifAutoSchedulerIntro: Periodic background check via chat_completion as the selected user. Optionally Telegram to the same linked user ID — daily limit against spam.
ifAutoNotifyOnly: Notify only when not SCHEDULER_OK / JSON notify:false
ifAutoPackages: Tool packages (allowlist, comma-separated) — only in allowlist mode
ifAutoLegacyNote: Legacy IDE/PIDEA removed. Persisted jobs: general (agent general) and coding (workspace agent coding, workspace_id required). Worker timeout applies to both targets.
ifAutoPersistedJobsIntro: Background thread for saved jobs (registry agent_id, e.g. general, coding).
ifPlatformUploadIntro: Global limits for gallery uploads (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP). Empty = environment variables AGENT_DASHBOARD_UPLOAD_MAX_MB / AGENT_DASHBOARD_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_MIME.
ifPlatformUploadMaxMb: Max. file size (MB), empty = env/default only
ifPlatformUploadMime: Allowed MIME types (comma-separated), empty = env/default only
ifPlatformWorkspacesIntro: Project workspaces for Chat (repo tools and sub-agents).
ifPlatformSelfWorkspaceHint: When enabled, Chat shows an extra workspace agentlayer-self. This is a writable copy under AGENTLAYER_WORKSPACE_PATH/<user_id>/agentlayer-self, seeded on first access from /workspace/AgentLayer or /app. No auto-update; reset/re-seed is explicit.
ifPlatformAgentModeIntro: AGENT_MODE in .env is the default (sandbox = Docker-bound: tools always run as container for policy; host = allow host-class overrides per tool policy). Here you can override that for the running deployment (saved in the database). Choose "Use environment" to clear the override.
ifPlatformMediaIntro: User audio/video library and dashboard media player. Off by default. Empty numeric fields use environment defaults (AGENT_MEDIA_*).
ifPlatformMediaEffective: Effective: max upload {{bytes}} bytes · MIME: {{mime}} · default user quota {{quotaMb}} MB
ifPlatformMediaSharingEnabled: Allow sharing (stage 3 — uploads with license only)
ifPlatformVoiceIntro: Separate STT and TTS provider chains: VOICE_STT_PROVIDER_N_* and VOICE_TTS_PROVIDER_N_* in .env (like EMBEDDING_PROVIDER_N). OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions and /audio/speech.
ifPlatformVoiceSttTtsEnvHint: STT and TTS are separate provider lists — configure VOICE_STT_PROVIDER_1_* and VOICE_TTS_PROVIDER_1_* (not VOICE_PROVIDER_N).
mediaQuotaUpdateFailed: Could not update media storage quota.
ifPlatformIndexOnAttach: Background index when workspace opens (if stale)
ifBridgeDiscordIntro: Application id is a hint for integrations. The in-process bridge runs inside agent-layer; users link their numeric Discord user id under Settings → Connections. With a trigger prefix, only messages that start with it are handled; leave the prefix field empty so the bot reacts to every text message in the channel (only linked users; noisy in busy servers). Chat runs in-process as the linked AgentLayer user.
ifBridgeTelegramIntro: Bot username / hint for integrations. The in-process bridge runs inside agent-layer; users link their numeric Telegram user id under Settings → Connections. With a trigger prefix, only messages that start with it are handled; leave the prefix field empty so the bot reacts to every text message (only linked users; in groups set @BotFather /setprivacy to Disable so the bot sees normal messages). Chat runs in-process as the linked AgentLayer user.
ifBridgeHttpClientLogLabel: HTTP client logging (httpx / long-poll) — in operator_settings, not in .env
toolsRegistryIntro: Grouping comes from each module's TOOL_BUCKET / TOOL_ADMIN_TAGS (shown as bucket and registry tags). Save policy updates package enabled state, minimum role, and optional tenant allowlist (comma-separated tenants.id; leave empty for any tenant). Run context is from the manifest and operator interfaces, not this page.
toolsRegistryAssignUsers: Assign users to tenants under Admin → Users.
toolsBucketUnsorted: Unsorted (set TOOL_BUCKET in the tool module)
schedulesIntro: Persisted schedules (scheduler_jobs). Doc/coverage presets use a workspace agent (e.g. coding) on a project workspace. Enable the worker under Admin → Interfaces first.
schedulesCreateHelpUser: Creates a new scheduler job for your user.
schedulesNoWorkspacesHint: No workspaces — create one in Chat or via workspace tools
usersCreated: Created login for {{email}} (role: {{role}}, tenant_id: {{tenantId}}). They can sign in at /login.
